name: Proximal Operator
definition: A generalization of projections on convex sets, used in proximal algorithms to solve non-smooth, constrained, or large-scale optimization problems by getting closer to the optimal solution while staying close to the current estimate.
summary: The proximal operator decomposes complex optimization problems into simpler sub-problems by minimizing a function plus a quadratic penalty, enabling efficient handling of non-smooth regularization in tomographic reconstruction.
